analysis.session_summary: The full trading day was driven by a hawkish BoE vote: the MPC came in 9-0-0 versus 7-0-2 forecast, lifting GBP. Meanwhile, risk aversion dominated as VIX jumped 33.16% to 23.389, pushing JPY and CHF to the top while AUD fell hardest. EUR/USD was choppy and netted only +4.3 pips, with no high-confidence catalysts for most legs. The tape closes with safe havens bid, GBP firm, and commodity FX weak.

themes.evidence: MPC vote actual 9-0-0 vs forecast 7-0-2; GBP strength +0.15%; EUR/GBP -0.045%.
Most USD and EUR legs had no clear catalyst; AUD/USD dropped 64.4 pips on no own releases.

currency_drivers.GBP: BoE vote came in at 9-0-0 versus 7-0-2 forecast, a hawkish surprise that strengthened the pound.
currency_drivers.AUD: No catalyst of its own; suffered broad decline as the weakest major.
currency_drivers.CAD: Own speaker was muted; early attempt rejected and closed slightly softer.
currency_drivers.CHF: Own speaker was muted, but the franc drew safe-haven demand.
currency_drivers.NZD: No catalyst of its own; early gains were fully faded.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Four choppy legs (-18.5p, +49.0p, -56.4p, +28.5p) netted +4.3 pips; no high-confidence catalyst.
